info.title: Chunkify analytics collector API
info.description: Collect playback events, query analytics, and manage your project. Analytics reads share configurable per-project budgets across HTTP and MCP: defaults are 120 reads/minute with burst 20, at most 2 queued/running reads per project and 8 server-wide. Export link creation and downloads have separate project budgets. Rate/concurrency rejections return 429 with Retry-After. Limits use continuous refill and reset on collector restart, not key rotation. Configure [rate_limits] in config.toml.

get.summary: Read totals for a view cohort
get.description: Get views, unique viewer IDs, and playing time for matching playback attempts. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name, device_type, continent, country or city. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups.

get.description: List per-video totals. Sort the entire filtered cohort by video_id, views, unique_viewers, total_playing_time_ms or playback_score before pagination. Defaults to video_id ascending. Missing scores come last; metric ties use video_id ascending in both directions. Unique viewer counts cannot be added across videos. Keep sort_by, order and filters unchanged with a cursor.

get.summary: Get summary, quality or engagement metrics over time
get.description: Supply from, to and interval=hour|day. kind defaults to summary and also accepts quality or engagement. Every bucket selects first retained starts in its UTC interval and includes each selected view's whole retained measurement and errors, even after to. Empty buckets have zero counts and null unavailable measurements or ratios. At most 1000 buckets. Unique viewer counts are not additive.

get.summary: Read playback quality for a view cohort
get.description: Get startup time, buffering, and observed fatal errors for matching playback attempts. Null means unavailable. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name, device_type, continent, country or city. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups. Includes mutually exclusive startup outcomes; unknown outcomes remain explicit.

200.description: Playback-quality metrics and sample counts for selected starts.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

413.description: Request size exceeds the configured limit.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

get.summary: Read average watch time and reached-end rate
get.description: Get average watch time per attempt and the observed reached-end rate. Reaching the end does not prove the whole video was watched. Optionally group the full filtered view-start cohort with group_by=browser_name, os_name, device_type, continent, country or city. Without group_by the totals response is unchanged. With group_by, return paginated groups sorted by value ascending, null first. Context comes from the first retained start; missing, null and nonstring values form a null group. Keep group_by and filters unchanged with each cursor. Unique viewers must not be summed across groups. Includes furthest-progress milestones and measured watch-time distribution. Progress can include seeking and is not retention.

get.description: List key IDs, names, and types. Key values are not returned. Requires a full-access private key; read-only keys receive 403.

200.description: Project keys.

post.description: Create a named public ingestion key or secret key in the authenticated project. Secret keys default to full project access; set read_only to true for analytics reads and exports only. Requires a full-access project secret key. Read-only keys receive 403 and the installation admin key is not accepted. The key is active immediately and its value is returned once; store it before leaving this response. Each project supports at most 64 active keys, including its initial keys.

403.description: Valid read-only private key; full-access private key required for project and key management.

413.description: Request body exceeds the size limit.

500.description: The change could not be saved.

409.description: The project already has 64 active keys.

post.description: Replace a key in this project. The old value stops working immediately. Save the returned replacement. Requires a full-access private key; read-only keys receive 403. Only the selected key is rotated. If its replacement is lost, a trusted backend can rotate it again through the installation admin API.

get.description: One row per first retained start, using the same final/latest measurement selection as metrics. Filter by identity, context, dates or has_fatal_error. Order by started_at descending by default (newest first), or ascending with order=asc. Equal start times use view_id in the same direction. Cursors bind filters, order, fatal-error selection, project and ingestion watermark. Missing end or error events are not proof of an ongoing or successful playback. Sort the entire matching cohort by sort_by before pagination, with missing values last.

200.description: View page; next_cursor is null at the end.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

get.description: Returns start context and selected measurements, plus a paginated history of all retained events for that view ID, in ingestion order. SDK sequence and occurrence times remain in each event. Follow next_cursor with the same view ID; the summary and event pages share the initial ingestion watermark. Orphaned events without a retained start remain available through /v1/events?view_id=... .

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

get.description: Filters select first retained starts. Error events from the selected view identity contribute even after to. Group by exact JSON error_code and fatal status, distinguishing numeric codes from text and missing from false. Sort by the canonical JSON code and fatal status ascending. error_events counts distinct event IDs per group, affected_views counts distinct view IDs. Groups are not additive across codes. Cursors exclude later arrivals.

post.summary: Generate a CSV report on request
post.description: Create a scoped 256-bit random download token for all matching rows. Requires a project private key; read-only keys are allowed. The link expires after 30 minutes and is invalidated by issuer-key rotation/revocation, project deletion or collector restart. No CSV is generated or retained at creation. limit/cursor are rejected. Existing query endpoints continue returning JSON. Event CSV files contain documented scalar event fields and flat context.* columns. Custom attributes, nested arrays and historical OTLP payloads are excluded. CSV cells never contain JSON objects or arrays; use GET /v1/events for original payloads.

201.description: Scoped download link. Treat this URL as a secret.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

413.description: Request size exceeds the configured limit.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

get.description: The token authorizes only its saved project and query. Requires no Authorization header and accepts no query parameters. Generate CSV on demand from one read snapshot on a dedicated connection; stream with bounded application buffers and backpressure. Dataset is selected when the link is opened. Rows are not capped by query pagination. Nested metric columns use slash-separated paths. Events have documented scalar columns and flat context.* columns. Custom attributes, nested arrays and historical OTLP payloads are excluded. CSV cells never contain JSON objects or arrays. Nulls are empty cells; spreadsheet-formula strings are prefixed with an apostrophe. Interrupted or failed downloads terminate the stream; retry the full download. No files are retained. Defaults: 2 download starts/minute per project with burst capacity 2, one active CSV generation per project and four server-wide. Limits are shared across keys and links. Excess requests receive 429 with Retry-After instead of queueing. Override limits in config.toml [rate_limits]. Link expiry is checked before starting, not during an active download. S3 retention/deletion can remove source objects during a download.

200.description: CSV generated directly as a streamed attachment.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, or pagination cursor.

404.description: Download token is invalid, expired or revoked.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

get.description: Count views along the video using recorded played ranges. Requires video_id. Uses the final measurement, or the latest snapshot without an end event, for each retained start matching the date and audience filters. Each attempt counts once in each section it overlapped, including replays. Skipped sections do not count. Older events without played ranges and attempts without a finite positive duration are excluded from sample_views. Returns at most 200 consecutive buckets, including zero counts, at a width of at least one second. This is media position, not wall-clock time.

200.description: Complete engagement curve for the matching measured attempts.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, limit, or unsupported query parameters.

413.description: Request size exceeds the configured limit.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

500.description: Storage operation failed or a numeric aggregate exceeded the finite response range.

get.summary: Read rendition watch time and average bitrate
get.description: Summarize rendition measurements for the filtered view-start cohort. Use only the selected final event, or latest snapshot when no final exists. Expand its cumulative rendition_playing_time array once per view. Missing or empty measurements contribute no rendition time. Rank by playing time descending; limit bounds returned rows only, while totals and average cover every matching rendition. Average bitrate is sum(bitrate_bps * playing_time_ms) divided by playing time with a known bitrate. Dimensions, codec, bitrate and frame rate together identify a rendition. Views can contribute to several renditions and must not be summed. No cursor, group_by, sort_by or order. Export resource=renditions includes all matching rows.

200.description: Filtered rendition totals and ranked watch-time rows.

400.description: Invalid filters, dates, limit, or unsupported query parameters.

413.description: Request size exceeds the configured limit.

429.description: Project request rate or project/server concurrency limit exceeded. Retry-After is the rounded-up delay in seconds; concurrency rejections use one second.

500.description: Storage operation failed or a numeric aggregate exceeded the finite response range.

publicKey.name: X-Chunkify-Ingest-Key
publicKey.description: Public key starting with ck_public_. Use it in the player to send events.

secretKey.description: Private key starting with ck_secret_. Full-access keys read analytics and manage one project. Read-only private keys access analytics and MCP only. Keep all private keys out of browser code.

adminKey.description: Installation admin key from CHUNKIFY_ADMIN_KEY. Creates projects and lists or rotates their keys for recovery. Keep it in a trusted backend and verify project ownership before using it for a customer.

export_resource.name: resource
export_resource.description: Report whose CSV columns to list.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time lower bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event. Must be before to.

to.name: to
to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time upper bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event.

retention_video_id.name: video_id
retention_video_id.description: Video to report. Retention measures one video at a time.

video_id.name: video_id
video_id.description: Exact video ID. Combined with all other filters using AND.

viewer_id.name: viewer_id
viewer_id.description: Exact supplied viewer ID. Missing/null viewer IDs do not match.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: Raw-event queries only. Summaries and videos reject this parameter.

browser_name.name: browser_name
browser_name.description: Exact browser name, such as Chrome. Missing values do not match.

os_name.name: os_name
os_name.description: Exact operating-system name, such as macOS. Missing values do not match.

device_type.name: device_type
device_type.description: Exact device class. unknown matches an explicit unknown value.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum rows on this page. Events and videos always support pagination; summary, quality and engagement support it only with group_by.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Use next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same filters, sort_by and order. Video cursors from earlier versions are invalid; start a new pagination sequence after upgrading.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional browser origin. When supplied it must exactly match server.allowed_origins. Origin-less server requests are allowed with the public key.

identity_encoding.name: Content-Encoding
identity_encoding.description: JSON requests accept an absent Content-Encoding header or identity. Compression is not supported.

timeseries_from.name: from
timeseries_from.description: Inclusive view-start time in RFC3339 format with a timezone.

timeseries_to.name: to
timeseries_to.description: Exclusive view-start time in RFC3339 format with a timezone. Must be later than from.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: UTC hour or day. The requested range can contain at most 1000 buckets.

order.name: order
order.description: Sort direction. Events and videos default to asc; views default to desc. Events sort by ingestion sequence. Videos and views sort by sort_by with missing values last. View ties use view_id in the requested direction; video metric ties use video_id ascending.

view_sort_by.name: sort_by
view_sort_by.description: Sort all matching sessions before pagination. Missing values come last in both directions. Ties use view_id in the requested direction. Keep sort_by, order and filters unchanged with a cursor.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: Rank all matching videos before pagination. Missing scores come last in both directions. Metric ties use video_id ascending. Keep sort_by, order and filters unchanged with a cursor.

group_by.name: group_by
group_by.description: Optional on summary, quality and engagement. Group views by this field on their first retained start. Missing, null and nonstring context forms a null group; the literal device type unknown stays separate. Groups sort by value ascending, null first. Pagination is available only with group_by. Location uses the first retained start too. City groups use the stored name; filter by country to avoid combining names shared by different countries. Page groups use the first retained start even if playback continues after navigation. Filter by page_origin when grouping page_path to distinguish identical paths on different sites.

view_id.name: view_id
view_id.description: Filter one playback attempt by view ID. Metrics use its first retained start.

dimension_path.name: dimension
dimension_path.description: Discover values from first retained view-start context, with view counts.

metric_kind.name: kind
metric_kind.description: Metric set for every time bucket. Uses the same calculations and sample counts as the corresponding totals route.

has_fatal_error.name: has_fatal_error
has_fatal_error.description: Select attempts with or without an observed fatal error. Absence of an observed error does not prove successful playback.

export_token.name: token
export_token.description: Unguessable scoped download credential. No project key is needed.

continent.name: continent
continent.description: Exact continent code from the local lookup. Missing locations do not match.

country.name: country
country.description: Exact uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as GB. Missing locations do not match.

city.name: city
city.description: Exact, case-sensitive city name from the local lookup, with 1 to 256 Unicode characters. Use country alongside city to distinguish places with the same name. Missing locations do not match.

page_origin.name: page_origin
page_origin.description: Exact, case-sensitive page origin captured by the player, such as https://example.com. Metrics use the first retained view start; raw events use each event context. Missing values do not match.

page_path.name: page_path
page_path.description: Exact, case-sensitive page path captured by the player, such as /watch/video. Filter by page_origin as well to distinguish identical paths on different sites. Metrics use the first retained view start; raw events use each event context. Missing values do not match.

views_order.name: order
views_order.description: Sort by started_at and then view_id in this direction. Defaults to newest first. Keep the same order with each cursor.

AnalyticsEvent.description: A schema version 1 playback event. Extra properties are preserved.

visibility_state.description: Tab visibility when the event was recorded. Hidden does not imply paused playback or identify the cause of a pause. Missing on older events; null when unavailable.

browser_context.description: Optional browser information supplied by the player.

played_ranges.description: Cumulative played media ranges for this attempt, sorted and merged without overlaps. Seeking, pauses and buffering are excluded. Missing or null means unavailable; an empty array means measured but no section played. Replaying a section does not add another range.

playhead_seconds.description: Current media position at this event, not the maximum reached.

page_origin.description: Current document HTTP(S) origin, without credentials. Null when unavailable or longer than 2048 characters.

page_path.description: Current document pathname, without query parameters or fragment. Null when unavailable or longer than 2048 characters. Paths may contain application-defined identifiers.

BrowserContext.description: Browser and device information reported by the player. Unavailable measurements are null.

user_agent.description: Copied from browser_context.user_agent when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

browser_name.description: Copied from browser_context.browser_name when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

browser_version.description: Copied from browser_context.browser_version when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

os_name.description: Copied from browser_context.os_name when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

os_version.description: Copied from browser_context.os_version when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

device_type.description: Copied from browser_context.device_type when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

device_family.description: Copied from browser_context.device_family when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

language.description: Copied from browser_context.language when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

language_prefix.description: Copied from browser_context.language_prefix when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

timezone.description: Copied from browser_context.timezone when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

timezone_offset_minutes.description: Copied from browser_context.timezone_offset_minutes when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

screen_width_px.description: Copied from browser_context.screen_width_px when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

screen_height_px.description: Copied from browser_context.screen_height_px when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

viewport_width_px.description: Copied from browser_context.viewport_width_px when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

viewport_height_px.description: Copied from browser_context.viewport_height_px when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

pixel_ratio.description: Copied from browser_context.pixel_ratio when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

country.description: Country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code from the local City MMDB lookup. Null when unknown. The request IP is discarded.

city.description: Approximate city name in English from the local City MMDB lookup. Null when unknown. Location displays using the bundled DB-IP data must link to https://db-ip.com.

page_origin.description: Current document HTTP(S) origin, without credentials. Null when unavailable or longer than 2048 characters.

page_path.description: Current document pathname, without query parameters or fragment. Null when unavailable or longer than 2048 characters. Paths may contain application-defined identifiers.

continent.description: Continent code from the local City MMDB lookup: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania or South America. Null when unknown.

EventContext.description: Browser context and locally derived continent/country/city. Request IP addresses are never added to events or stored context.

project_id.description: Trusted project identifier resolved from the public key. Historical events migrate to default.

ingest_key_id.description: ID of the public key used to receive this event. Null when unavailable.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

bytesValue.description: Only an explicit null is accepted; non-null bytesValue attributes are unsupported.

OtlpAttributeValue.description: A typed log attribute. At most one value field can be set. Binary values are unsupported.

OtlpAttribute.description: An absent or null key decodes to the empty string; duplicate decoded keys reject the request. An absent value decodes to null.

OtlpAnyValue.description: Standard OTLP AnyValue in a preserved resource, scope or body. This collector does not decode these fields into the event.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

OtlpLogRecord.description: A playback event in log attributes. Duplicate attributes and invalid event fields reject the request.

StoredOtlpContext.description: Legacy context present for an event received through OTLP by an earlier collector version. Existing context remains readable; new ingestion accepts native JSON events only.

bucket_start.description: UTC interval start in RFC3339 with milliseconds and Z. May precede from in a partial first bucket; only starts inside [from, to) contribute.

from.description: Inclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

to.description: Exclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed attempts.

sample_views.description: Views with a non-null startup measurement on the selected final event or latest snapshot.

median.description: Continuous median startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

p95.description: Continuous 95th percentile startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

startup_time_ms.description: Time from attempt to first playing, measured once per eligible view. This is not first-frame timing.

sample_views.description: Views with playing and rebuffer durations available and positive combined duration.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Sum of playing time for eligible buffering samples only.

total_rebuffer_duration_ms.description: Sum of rebuffer time for the same samples.

ratio.description: Total rebuffer time divided by combined playing and rebuffer time. Null without samples. Multiply by 100 for percent.

buffering.description: Duration-weighted buffering. Startup wait, pauses and seeking are excluded by the SDK. Unknown durations are not treated as zero.

affected_views.description: Distinct selected views with at least one observed matching fatal playback_error, including before playback starts.

ratio.description: Affected views divided by all selected attempts; null when views is zero. Multiply by 100 for percent.

fatal_errors.description: Observed fatal errors. Lost events can undercount this metric; absence of an error is not proof of successful playback.

Quality.description: Playback quality for the same start cohort as summary. All rates are fractions. Counts expose measurement coverage.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed, ongoing and start-only attempts.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Cumulative playing time summed once per selected view, as in summary.

average_playing_time_ms.description: Total playing time divided by all selected attempts. Null with no views; zero when views exist with no measured time.

reached_end_views.description: Views whose winning final event has reason=ended. Counts each selected view at most once.

reached_end_ratio.description: Reached-end views divided by all selected attempts. Null without views. Multiply by 100 for percent. Does not imply the whole video was watched.

Engagement.description: Observed watch time and end-of-media for the same start cohort as summary. Missing delivery can undercount both.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed attempts.

sample_views.description: Views with a non-null startup measurement on the selected final event or latest snapshot.

median.description: Continuous median startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

p95.description: Continuous 95th percentile startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

startup_time_ms.description: Time from attempt to first playing, measured once per eligible view. This is not first-frame timing.

sample_views.description: Views with playing and rebuffer durations available and positive combined duration.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Sum of playing time for eligible buffering samples only.

total_rebuffer_duration_ms.description: Sum of rebuffer time for the same samples.

ratio.description: Total rebuffer time divided by combined playing and rebuffer time. Null without samples. Multiply by 100 for percent.

buffering.description: Duration-weighted buffering. Startup wait, pauses and seeking are excluded by the SDK. Unknown durations are not treated as zero.

affected_views.description: Distinct selected views with at least one observed matching fatal playback_error, including before playback starts.

ratio.description: Affected views divided by all selected attempts; null when views is zero. Multiply by 100 for percent.

fatal_errors.description: Observed fatal errors. Lost events can undercount this metric; absence of an error is not proof of successful playback.

sort_by.description: Videos or views only. Use a sort field supported by the selected resource. Defaults to video_id for videos and started_at for views.

page_origin.description: Exact, case-sensitive page_origin from the first retained view start, or each event for raw-event exports.

page_path.description: Exact, case-sensitive page_path from the first retained view start, or each event for raw-event exports.

columns.description: Available CSV column names in default output order.

CSV column names in output order. Omit for all columns. Get the available names from GET /v1/exports using the same resource, kind and group_by. Unknown names, duplicates and empty selections are rejected.

MetricCountRatio.description: View count and fraction of its documented denominator. The ratio is null when that denominator is zero.

ProgressReached.description: Furthest progress on the selected final event or latest snapshot. Only views with a positive known media duration and a progress ratio in [0,1] are samples. Each milestone ratio uses sample_views. Seeking can count; this is not watched coverage or audience retention.

distribution.description: Mutually exclusive playing-time buckets: [0,10s), [10s,30s), [30s,60s), [1m,5m), [5m,infinity). Counts sum to sample_views.

WatchTimeDistribution.description: Playing time in milliseconds from one selected final event or latest snapshot per view. Measured zero is included; missing measurements are excluded. Percentiles use linear interpolation and are null without samples. This sample denominator differs from average_playing_time_ms, which uses all attempts.

StartupOutcomes.description: Mutually exclusive outcomes. An explicit startup_outcome on the selected final event takes precedence. Otherwise an available startup time, including zero, or positive playing time on the selected measurement proves started. All other views are unknown. sample_views excludes unknown; every ratio uses all selected attempts, including unknown. Missing final delivery does not prove an exit or failure.

name.description: Key display name, up to 128 UTF-8 bytes. Whitespace-only names are rejected.

read_only.description: Only secret keys can be read-only. False grants full project management access to secret keys; public keys only ingest events.

CreatedProjectKey.description: A newly created key. Save the key value now; later key listings contain only metadata.

end_seconds.description: Exclusive media position in seconds, greater than start_seconds.

views.description: All matching attempts with a retained start.

sample_views.description: Attempts whose selected final or latest snapshot contains played ranges and a finite positive media duration. Includes measured empty ranges.

duration_seconds.description: Longest measured duration in this selection. Null when there are no measured attempts.

interval_seconds.description: Bucket width, ceil(duration_seconds / 200), with a minimum of one second. Null without measurements.

start_seconds.description: Inclusive start of the video section.

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end of the section, capped at the reported duration.

views.description: Distinct attempts that played any part of this section. Each attempt counts at most once.
All attempts in the filtered start cohort.

sample_views.description: Attempts with positive measured rendition playing time.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Total measured rendition playing time across all matching rows. Can be less than overall watch time when rendition information is missing.

bitrate_sample_playing_time_ms.description: Measured playing time with a known rendition bitrate, used as the average denominator.

average_bitrate_bps.description: Time-weighted mean declared bitrate. Null without playing time with a known bitrate.

total_renditions.description: Number of distinct renditions before applying the row limit.

renditions.description: Most-played renditions first. Defaults to 100 rows, maximum 1000. CSV exports include all matching rows.

RenditionMetric.description: One rendition identified by its dimensions, codec, declared bitrate and frame rate.

width.description: Reported width in pixels; null when unknown.

height.description: Reported height in pixels; null when unknown.

bitrate_bps.description: Declared rendition bitrate in bits per second, not measured network throughput.

frame_rate.description: Reported frames per second; null when unknown.

views.description: Distinct attempts with positive playing time for this rendition.

playing_time_ms.description: Cumulative measured playing time for this rendition, summed once per attempt.

playing_time_ratio.description: Share of all measured rendition playing time, including rows outside the returned limit.

value.description: Mean of measured per-session playback scores, or null without scored sessions. Each session uses startup = 8 / (8 + startup_time_ms / 1000), smoothness = exp(-10 * buffering_ratio), and scores 100 * startup^0.30 * smoothness^0.70. Buffering ratio is rebuffer duration divided by playing plus rebuffer duration. The 30% startup and 70% smoothness weights are heuristic. A recorded fatal error or failed_before_start outcome scores zero. Other sessions require positive playing time and known startup and rebuffer durations; ended_before_start and unknown outcomes are unscored. Buffering excludes startup, pauses and seeks. The score does not use interruption count or measure picture quality.

sample_views.description: Sessions contributing a score, including recorded failures. A per-session result is zero or one.
